**Overall Summary**: This phase of data cleaning will

-  Create codebooks for public release
:::

## Preparations
### Packages
```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, haven, labelled)
```

### Import Dataset
```{r}
p5_ego_data <- readRDS("work_data/p2_data.Rds")
```

## Ego Data
### Drop Alter Items
```{r}
p5_ego_data <- p5_ego_data %>%
  select(-(523:2071))
```

### Drop Duplicates and Abnormal Respondents
```{r}
p5_ego_data <- p5_ego_data %>%
  filter(ageyear < 30)
```

### Drop Non-Public Items
```{r}
p5_ego_data <- p5_ego_data %>%
  select(-(aw_fet1:aw_fet5))
```

### Manual Fix
```{r}
p5_ego_data <- p5_ego_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(sex_id_combo, sex1:sex2, sex4, 
                  not_rel, rel_curr_id1, rel_curr_id,
                  rel_past_id2, rel_past_id,
                  relid_life), as.factor))
```


### Create Codebook
```{r}
source("functions/codebook_html.R")

codebook_html(p5_ego_data, "docs/codebook.html", title = "SGM Networks Codebook - Public Access")
```
